points.description: Closed-loop poles: characteristic equation s^2 + (a+b k2)s + (c+b k1) = s^2 + 4s + 8 = 0, giving poles s = -2 ± 2j (both stated). Equivalent derivations accepted.

levels.says: Correct closed-loop characteristic polynomial s^2+4s+8 but poles wrong or not stated.

points.description: Nff = 8, obtained from a stated DC-gain condition (set derivatives to zero / s=0 in the transfer function b Nff/(s^2+4s+8), so theta_ss = Nff/8 r = r). Bare value 8 with no DC-gain condition shown does not earn full marks.

levels.says: Correct DC-gain expression theta_ss = Nff/8 r (or equivalent) but final Nff wrong, or Nff = 8 stated without any DC-gain reasoning.

rubric.notes: Full marks: poles -2±2j and Nff = 8 with DC-gain reasoning. Part marks as per levels for correct polynomial or correct DC-gain expression with an error. An error in the poles that carries into Nff still allows the method mark only if the DC-gain condition is stated.
rubric.answer_key: Closed loop: θ̈ + (a+b k2)θ̇ + (c+b k1)θ = b Nff r → s²+4s+8=0 → s = -2 ± 2j. DC gain: θ_ss = b Nff/(c+b k1) r = Nff/8 r = r → Nff = 8.
